decisions.verdict: Install 10 kWp solar, stay on your current tariff
evidence: 10 kWp: saves RM502.75/month, payback 5.8 years, 77% of solar used on site
Without solar: switch to the ToU tariff (ToU saves RM7.6)
With solar: stay on flat; ToU would cost RM1.39 more
Peak share 58.3% → 64.9% after solar (break-even 63.6%): solar removes mostly off-peak use
5 kWp: saves RM296.48/month, payback 4.9 years, 91% of solar used on site
15 kWp: saves RM638.56/month, payback 6.9 years, 65% of solar used on site
ruled_out: Adding both savings (RM7.6 + RM502.75 = RM510.35): they overlap
15 kWp: the extra 5 kWp pays back in 10.7 years, beyond the 10-year Solar ATAP term
assumptions: Installed cost RM3500 per kWp, derate 0.8 (installer quotes to confirm)
Exported solar valued at RM0 (credit terms vary; confirm under Solar ATAP)
Generation from real hourly radiation at the outlet (Open-Meteo)
Rates used: peak RM0.5217, off-peak RM0.4808, flat RM0.5068 per kWh (all-in; confirm against TNB's schedule)
Sample data: business data is synthetic, weather and holidays are real
